name: Algebraic Constraint Obfuscation
description: Preserves the exact nonpreemptive two-machine scheduling execution model to satisfy G3, but redefines the physical impossibility certificates as systems of algebraic inequalities. The non-overlapping constraint is obfuscated as `max(x_u, x_v) >= min(x_u + p1_u, x_v + p1_v)`, forcing models to deduce that this implies `sum(p1) > T` rather than relying on surface pattern matching of keywords like "capacity" or "overlap".
